$schema_comment: Extensible mission-pack registry. Add a new file under packs/ and list it here to register a 5th pack.

packs.name: Core
packs.summary: OSINT/job/blog/repo leads, DNS/CT (crt.sh), authorized port probes, tech fingerprint (headers/cookies/JS), robots.txt + sitemap.xml, common static paths, and PHP/stack signals (phpinfo-like stubs, framework headers/cookies, .php paths).

packs.name: WordPress
packs.summary: generator meta, readme.html, wp-includes versioned assets, plugin asset paths, xmlrpc, wp-json routes, theme style.css headers. Discovery-only.

packs.name: API
packs.summary: OpenAPI/Swagger HTML+JSON, GraphQL discoverable endpoint with introspection-disabled stub, Actuator health, nested /api/v1 from JS, plus exposure indicators (auth-required vs public, CORS/headers, verbose errors, unauthenticated list routes). Zero-exploitation.

packs.name: Documents
packs.summary: robots/sitemap links to pdf/txt/md/csv/json, directory listing stubs, backup-looking filenames (harmless content), .git/HEAD indicator only (no object dump).

packs.name: OSINT
packs.summary: Deep passive OSINT on one selection (no live HostAfrica): search dorks (templates), Certificate Transparency SAN inventory (crt.sh), DNS/subdomain from public resolvers (DoH), web archives (Wayback CDX), public leak hunting (report-don't-auth, fake secrets only), and BFF/proxy edge mapping from public JS/headers. Fixtures load from lab/osint/ (static files); optional live public-aggregator adapters behind --live-osint (default OFF). Passive/discovery only.
